metadataRaw.title: How to Strengthen Your Diaphragm (BREATHE EASIER!)
metadataRaw.description:
Struggling with your breathing? This video is here to help. Dr. Rowe walks you through six simple and effective exercises to strengthen your diaphragm, the key muscle that helps you breathe with ease.

By improving your diaphragm strength, you can gain better control over your breathing and make each breath feel smoother and more natural. Each exercise targets your diaphragm in a different way, so try them all and see which ones work best for you.

Click play and start breathing easier today!

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
0:29 Belly Breathing
1:44 The Joker
3:03 Breath Hold
4:38 Candle Method
5:59 Alt. Nasal Breathing
7:18 The Whistler
